history.cutoff: Predict complete date batch before applying any outcomes; reset all states by season
history.inputs: Only existing exact period outcomes, exact team IDs, dates and certified historical outcome lineage. No payload features, starters, lineups, exact lines or target outcomes in predictors.
history.certification_scope: Inherits the existing certified historical-development outcome contract and hashes; does not upgrade it to a prospective/as-published feature certificate.

baseline: Strict-prior same-season league modal outcome: ML chooses higher HOME/AWAY count, draws push;3way chooses HOME/AWAY/DRAW mode. Report eligible-population baseline and identical selected-cohort baseline; lift is accuracy difference in percentage points.
tuning: One fixed design per family; no parameter grids, threshold search, changed expert weights, external selection or post-result revision.

hierarchical.mechanism: Nested Dirichlet categorical outcome pooling: team overall W/L/D shrinks30pseudo games to pooled league team W/L/D; team venue W/L/D shrinks30 to its overall posterior. Combine home-venue W/L/D and reversed away-venue probabilities by product divided by prior league HOME/AWAY/DRAW probabilities, normalize.

kalman.mechanism: Joint Gaussian latent team run-margin states, full covariance. Observation is home-minus-away exact period runs; design vector +1home/-1away. Prior means0, independent variance2*period. Daily random-walk covariance inflation0.01*period per elapsed calendar day. Observation variance from strictly prior margins with20 pseudo observations variance2*period, lowerbound0.25. All batch predictions first, then standard full Kalman updates with same preday observation variance. Discretized predictive normal: DRAW integral[-0.5,+0.5], HOME above+0.5, AWAY below-0.5.

archetype.mechanism: Online unsupervised8-centroid kmeans of four normalized log scoring/allowing rates from last30 prior team games,10league-mean pseudo games. Seed with first8 eligible contexts in fixed date/gamePK order; all contexts from prior dates. Nearest centroid categorical HOME/AWAY/DRAW counts, Dirichlet20 toward prior league distribution. Require30 assigned prior contexts in predicted cluster. Update centroids by running average after complete date predictions. No label-driven cluster selection.

isotonic.mechanism: Direct monotonic conditional ML calibration of log home offense + log away allowed minus log away offense minus log home allowed; same last30 prior team games and10league-mean pseudo games. Require300 prior non-draw training contexts. Sort prior x, keep identical x together, bins at least30 cases, merge short final bin; bin Beta(1,1) rates, weighted PAVA. Predict step function at first block whose maxX >=x, clamp to edge block. DRAW probability is prior league Laplace rate; HOME=(1-draw)*p, AWAY=(1-draw)*(1-p). Fit once per date exclusively on prior labels.
